description: This file defines the `GatewayPush` enum, representing server-push messages from a gateway websocket in a Swift project. It includes cases for snapshot, event frames, and sequence gaps, and references external elements like `OpenClawProtocol`, `HelloOk`, and `EventFrame`. It also introduces a replacement mechanism for NotificationCenter.

methods.name: GatewayPush.snapshot
methods.description: Case capturing a full snapshot message, with associated data `HelloOk`.

methods.name: GatewayPush.event
methods.description: Case representing a server push event frame, with associated data `EventFrame`.

methods.name: GatewayPush.seqGap
methods.description: Case representing a detected sequence gap with `expected` and `received` sequence numbers.
